items.title: CVE-2026-46817: exploited vulnerability in Oracle E-Business Suite
items.note: Oracle E-Business Suite contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Payments. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Payments.

items.title: CVE-2023-4346: exploited vulnerability in KNX Association KNX Protocol Connection Authorization Option 1
items.note: KNX Association KNX Protocol Connection Authorization Option 1 contains an overly restrictive account lockout mechanism vulnerability that could allow an attacker to purge all devices without additional security options enabled and set a BCU key to lock the device.

items.title: CVE-2026-56155: exploited vulnerability in Microsoft Active Directory Federation Services
items.note: Microsoft Active Directory Federation Services contains an insufficient granularity of access control vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

items.title: CVE-2026-56164: exploited vulnerability in Microsoft SharePoint Server
items.note: Microsoft SharePoint contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

items.title: CVE-2026-15409: exploited vulnerability in SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances
items.note: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to potentially cause the appliance to make requests to unintended location.

items.title: CVE-2026-15410: exploited vulnerability in SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances
items.note: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contain a code injection vulnerability which in specific conditions could potentially enable a remote authenticated attacker as administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands.

items.title: CVE-2008-4128: exploited vulnerability in Cisco IOS
items.note: Cisco IOS 12.4 contains multiple cross-site forgery vulnerabilities that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via (1) a certain "show privilege" command to the /level/15/exec/- URI, and (2) a certain "alias exec" command to the /level/15/exec/-/configure/http URI.

items.title: CVE-2026-56291: exploited vulnerability in Balbooa Forms
items.note: Balbooa Forms contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated arbitrary file upload which could allow uploading of executable files leading to full RCE.

items.title: CVE-2026-48939: exploited vulnerability in iCagenda iCagenda
items.note: iCagenda contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows the upload of arbitrary files in the file attachment feature, ultimately resulting in PHP code upload and execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-48908: exploited vulnerability in JoomShaper SP Page Builder
items.note: JoomShaper SP Page Builder contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to upload arbitrary files, ultimately resulting in the upload and execution of PHP code.

items.title: CVE-2026-55255: exploited vulnerability in Langflow Langflow
items.note: Langflow contains an authorization bypass through user-controlled key vulnerability which allows an authenticated attacker to execute any flow belonging to another user by specifying the victim's flow ID in the request.

items.title: CVE-2026-56290: exploited vulnerability in Joomlack Page Builder
items.note: Joomlack Page Builder contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via unauthenticated arbitrary file upload.

items.title: CVE-2026-48282: exploited vulnerability in Adobe ColdFusion
items.note: Adobe ColdFusion contains a path traversal vulnerability that could lead to arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user.

items.title: CVE-2026-45659: exploited vulnerability in Microsoft SharePoint Server
items.note: Microsoft SharePoint Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability which allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

items.title: CVE-2026-48558: exploited vulnerability in SimpleHelp  SimpleHelp
items.note: SimpleHelp contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the OIDC authentication flow. When OIDC authentication is configured, identity tokens submitted during login are accepted without verifying their cryptographic signature. In a vulnerable configuration, a remote, unauthenticated attacker can submit a forged token containing arbitrary identity claims to obtain a fully authenticated technician session. In some configurations, this may also allow bypass of multi-factor authentication.

items.title: CVE-2016-9841: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: inffast.c in zlib 1.2.8 might allow context-dependent attackers to have unspecified impact by leveraging improper pointer arithmetic.

items.title: CVE-2020-26867: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: ARC Informatique PcVue prior to version 12.0.17 is vulnerable due to the deserialization of untrusted data, which may allow an attacker to remotely execute arbitrary code on the web and mobile back-end server.

items.title: CVE-2020-24881: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: SSRF exists in osTicket before 1.14.3, where an attacker can add malicious file to server or perform port scanning.

items.title: CVE-2020-35276: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: EgavilanMedia ECM Address Book 1.0 is affected by SQL injection. An attacker can bypass the Admin Login panel through SQLi and get Admin access and add or remove any user.

items.title: CVE-2021-27132: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: SerComm AG Combo VD625 AGSOT_2.1.0 devices allow CRLF injection (for HTTP header injection) in the download function via the Content-Disposition header.

items.title: CVE-2021-28860: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: In Node.js mixme, prior to v0.5.1, an attacker can add or alter properties of an object via '__proto__' through the mutate() and merge() functions. The polluted attribute will be directly assigned to every object in the program. This will put the availability of the program at risk causing a potential denial of service (DoS).

items.title: CVE-2021-36581: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: Kooboo CMS 2.1.1.0 is vulnerable to Insecure file upload. It is possible to upload any file extension to the server. The server does not verify the extension of the file and the tester was able to upload an aspx to the server.

items.title: CVE-2021-36582: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: In Kooboo CMS 2.1.1.0, it is possible to upload a remote shell (e.g., aspx) to the server and then call upon it to receive a reverse shell from the victim server. The files are uploaded to /Content/Template/root/reverse-shell.aspx and can be simply triggered by browsing that URL.

items.title: CVE-2021-42237: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: Sitecore XP 7.5 Initial Release to Sitecore XP 8.2 Update-7 is vulnerable to an insecure deserialization attack where it is possible to achieve remote command execution on the machine. No authentication or special configuration is required to exploit this vulnerability.

items.title: CVE-2021-41653: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: The PING function on the TP-Link TL-WR840N EU v5 router with firmware through TL-WR840N(EU)_V5_171211 is vulnerable to remote code execution via a crafted payload in an IP address input field.

items.title: CVE-2021-41435: recently changed critical CVE

items.title: CVE-2021-41716: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: Maharashtra State Electricity Board Mahavitara Android Application 8.20 and prior is vulnerable to remote account takeover due to OTP fixation vulnerability in password rest function

items.title: Sysco
items.source: Have I Been Pwned breach catalog

Data was subsequently published containing 2.7M unique email addresses belonging to staff and customers. The data also contained largely corporate contact information including names, phone numbers, physical addresses, internal job titles, and customer feedback.

Exposed data also included names, addresses, and phone numbers.

items.title: Data broker privacy watch
items.note: Recheck broker opt-out results every 30-90 days; many brokers repopulate data. Keep broker name, profile URL, date requested, and confirmation emails.

items.title: Unwanted software / bloatware watch
items.note: Watch for software that changes browser settings, injects ads, bundles unwanted offers, hides removal paths, exaggerates cleanup claims, or uses misleading install prompts.

items.title: Remote-access scam reminder
items.source: WireShield guidance from FTC/CISA-style scam prevention
items.note: Treat unexpected requests to install AnyDesk, TeamViewer, UltraViewer, RustDesk, or ScreenConnect as high risk, especially when paired with refunds, bank warnings, crypto, or gift cards.
